symptoms: rem terasa ngempos saat di injak
id.problem: Minyak rem habis/bocor, ada angin palsu di selang rem, atau master rem sentral jebol.
id.action: BAHAYA! Jangan paksakan jalan. Gunakan rem tangan perlahan jika darurat untuk berhenti.
id.garage_tip: Sampaikan: 'Rem saya ngempos/blong, tolong cek kebocoran minyak rem dan master remnya.'

symptoms: brake pedal feels soft when pressed
en.problem: Brake fluid leak, air in brake lines, or master cylinder failure.
en.action: DANGER! Do not continue driving. Use emergency handbrake gently if needed.
en.garage_tip: Say: 'My brakes failed/feel spongy, please check fluid leaks and master cylinder.'

symptoms: transmisi nyentak kasar saat pindah gigi
id.problem: Kualitas oli transmisi (ATF/CVTF) sudah jelek/berkurang, atau katup solenoid mampet.
id.action: Jangan panik. Kendarai mobil dengan pelan dan halus, hindari menginjak gas secara spontan.
id.garage_tip: Sampaikan: 'Mas, matic saya jedug, tolong cek kualitas oli matic-nya, jangan langsung disuruh turun mesin ya.'

en.problem: Degraded transmission fluid or clogged solenoid valves.
en.action: Drive gently and avoid sudden acceleration.
en.garage_tip: Say: 'Please check the transmission fluid first before suggesting a gearbox rebuild.'

id.problem: Sistem pembakaran tidak sempurna karena busi mati/lemah, koil bocor, atau filter bensin kotor.
id.action: Masih bisa dipakai jalan pelan untuk darurat, tapi jangan dipakai menyalip kendaraan lain.
id.garage_tip: Sampaikan: 'Tolong cek sistem pengapiannya dulu mas, mulai dari busi dan koil, baru cek tekanan fuel pump.'

en.problem: Incomplete combustion caused by worn spark plugs, leaking ignition coils, or weak fuel pump.
en.action: Drive slowly for emergencies, avoid rapid acceleration.
en.garage_tip: Say: 'Please check the ignition system, starting with spark plugs and coils, then test fuel pressure.'

symptoms: indikator aki warna merah menyala terus
id.problem: Aki (Accu) sudah soak/lemah, dinamo starter kotor, atau alternator tidak mengisi arus kelistrikan.
id.action: Lakukan jumper aki darurat. Jika mesin sudah menyala, jangan matikan mesin sampai tiba di bengkel.
id.garage_tip: Sampaikan: 'Tolong cek tegangan aki dan sistem pengisian alternator pakai multitester, jangan langsung vonis dinamo starter.'

symptoms: car hard to start in the morning
en.problem: Weak or dead battery, dirty starter motor, or failing alternator charging system.
en.action: Try a battery jump start. If the engine starts, do not turn it off until you reach a repair shop.
en.garage_tip: Say: 'Please check the battery voltage and alternator charging system with a multimeter before replacing the starter.'

symptoms: lampu indikator check engine kuning nyala
bensin terasa boros dan bau sangit
id.problem: Sensor O2 kotor/rusak, Mass Air Flow (MAF) sensor bermasalah, atau ada misfire di ruang bakar.
id.action: Kendaraan masih aman dikendarai sementara, namun segera periksakan agar konsumsi bensin tidak bocor.
id.garage_tip: Sampaikan: 'Tolong colok scanner komputer (OBD2) untuk membaca kode error Check Engine-nya yang pasti.'

symptoms: yellow check engine light is on
engine icon stays illuminated on dashboard
bad fuel economy and strong exhaust smell
en.problem: Dirty/faulty O2 sensor, problematic Mass Air Flow sensor, or engine misfire.
en.action: Vehicle is safe to drive temporarily, but get it checked soon to avoid wasting fuel.
en.garage_tip: Say: 'Please plug in the OBD2 computer scanner to read the exact Check Engine error code.'

symptoms: mobil mendadak mogok total di jalan
saat dikontak tidak ada bunyi dengung dari bawah jok belakang
distarter panjang tapi mesin tidak mau hidup
id.problem: Fuel pump (pompa bensin) mati total akibat kotoran di tangki, arus pendek, atau usia pakai.
id.action: Panggil layanan derek. Jangan terus-menerus memutar kunci kontak karena bisa merusak dinamo starter.
id.garage_tip: Sampaikan: 'Mobil mogok dan tidak ada suara pompa, tolong cek sekring fuel pump dan motor rotak di tangki bensin.'

symptoms: car suddenly stalls completely on the road
no humming sound from the fuel tank when ignition is on
en.problem: Fuel pump has completely failed due to tank debris, electrical short, or end of lifespan.
en.action: Call a tow truck. Do not keep cranking the engine as it will burn out the starter motor.
en.garage_tip: Say: 'Car stalled and there's no pump noise, please check the fuel pump fuse and the motor inside the gas tank.'

symptoms: tombol power window ditekan tidak ada reaksi
id.problem: Motor power window mati, saklar kotor berkarat, atau jalur rel kaca seret/putus kawatnya.
id.action: Jangan paksa menekan tombol terus menerus agar sekring atau motor tidak terbakar.
id.garage_tip: Sampaikan: 'Tolong cek arus listrik ke motor power window dan bersihkan saklarnya.'

symptoms: window cannot roll up or down
power window switch has no reaction
en.problem: Dead power window motor, dirty/corroded switch, or broken window regulator cable.
en.action: Do not force pressing the switch repeatedly to prevent burning the fuse.
en.garage_tip: Say: 'Please check the electrical current to the power window motor and clean the switch contacts.'

symptoms: bau kecut saat ac pertama dinyalakan
keluar debu putih dari kisi ac
id.problem: Filter kabin AC sudah sangat kotor/berjamur, atau Evaporator penuh lendir dan bakteri.
id.action: Matikan tombol AC (hanya hidupkan kipas) beberapa menit sebelum mesin dimatikan untuk mengeringkan embun evaporator.
id.garage_tip: Sampaikan: 'Tolong ganti filter kabin dan lakukan cuci evaporator AC tanpa bongkar dashboard (AC bersin).'

symptoms: car ac smells musty and sour
bad odor when ac is first turned on
white dust blowing from ac vents
en.problem: Cabin air filter is extremely dirty/moldy, or Evaporator is coated in slime and bacteria.
en.action: Turn off the AC compressor (fan only) a few minutes before shutting off the car to dry the evaporator.
en.garage_tip: Say: 'Please replace the cabin air filter and clean the AC evaporator without dismantling the dashboard.'

symptoms: bau gosong kap mesin saat nanjak
id.problem: Kampas kopling (matahari/dekrup) gosong karena sering gantung kopling atau sudah tipis/aus.
id.action: Jangan dipaksa menanjak curam atau membawa beban berat agar mobil tidak kehilangan tenaga total dan mundur.
id.garage_tip: Sampaikan: 'Sepertinya kampas kopling saya habis atau gosong, tolong turun transmisi dan ganti satu set koplingnya.'

en.problem: Clutch disc and pressure plate are burnt due to clutch slipping or normal wear and tear.
en.action: Avoid steep hills or heavy loads to prevent total power loss.
en.garage_tip: Say: 'The clutch seems burned out and slipping; please drop the transmission and replace the clutch set.'

symptoms: roda bunyi ngiung saat lari kencang
id.problem: Bearing roda (lakher) sudah aus, kering pelumas, atau pelor di dalamnya hancur.
id.action: Hindari perjalanan jauh berkecepatan tinggi karena bearing roda yang hancur bisa mengunci ban secara tiba-tiba.
id.garage_tip: Sampaikan: 'Tolong dongkrak dan putar roda untuk mengecek bearing roda mana yang berdengung, lalu press ganti baru.'

en.problem: Wheel bearings are worn out, dry, or damaged internally.
en.action: Avoid long high-speed trips as a failed wheel bearing can seize up suddenly.
en.garage_tip: Say: 'Please jack up and spin the wheels to identify the noisy bearing, then press in a new one.'

symptoms: suara tek tek halus kletek saat digas
id.problem: Bahan bakar beroktan rendah, ruang bakar banyak kerak karbon, atau timing pengapian tidak pas.
id.action: Isi bahan bakar dengan oktan lebih tinggi di pom bensin terdekat dan hindari putaran mesin tinggi.
id.garage_tip: Sampaikan: 'Mesin ngelitik parah, tolong lakukan gurah mesin (carbon clean) dan cek busi.'

en.problem: Low octane fuel, heavy carbon buildup in the combustion chamber, or incorrect ignition timing.
en.action: Fill up with higher octane fuel immediately and avoid heavy engine loads.
en.garage_tip: Say: 'The engine is pinging, please perform a carbon clean and inspect the spark plugs.'

symptoms: bunyi srek srek cicit saat direm
id.problem: Kampas rem sudah sangat tipis bergesekan dengan plat besi cakram, atau banyak debu dan kotoran terjebak.
id.action: Kurangi kecepatan berkendara karena pengereman bisa sedikit berkurang kepakemannya jika kampas habis.
id.garage_tip: Sampaikan: 'Tolong cek kampas rem depan, apakah sudah tipis dan perlu diganti, sekalian bersihkan kalipernya.'

en.problem: Brake pads are severely worn down rubbing against the rotor, or dirt is trapped.
en.action: Reduce driving speed as braking efficiency may be reduced if pads are worn out.
en.garage_tip: Say: 'Please check the front brake pads; they seem thin and need replacement, and clean the calipers.'

symptoms: ada tetesan oli warna hitam di lantai garasi
id.problem: Oli mesin bocor karena Seal Kruk As (Crankshaft) atau paking karter bak oli sudah getas/jebol.
id.action: Cabut stik oli (dipstick) dan cek kapasitas oli mesin. Jika masih di batas wajar, aman dipakai jalan perlahan.
id.garage_tip: Sampaikan: 'Ada tetesan oli, tolong cek sumber rembesannya, ganti seal kruk as atau lem ulang paking karter bak oli.'

symptoms: black oil drops on garage floor
en.problem: Engine oil leak due to hardened crankshaft seals or degraded oil pan gasket.
en.action: Check the oil dipstick level. If it's still at a safe level, it can be driven slowly.
en.garage_tip: Say: 'Please find the oil leak source, replace the crankshaft seal or reseal the oil pan gasket.'

symptoms: mesin mau mati saat ac nyala
id.problem: Throttle body kotor, Idle Speed Control (ISC) bermasalah, atau ada selang vacuum yang bocor.
id.action: Nyalakan AC dengan stabil dan hindari melepas gas secara mendadak di kemacetan agar mesin tidak mati.
id.garage_tip: Sampaikan: 'Tolong bersihkan throttle body dan kalibrasi ulang ISC-nya, sekalian cek selang vacuum.'

symptoms: engine rpm fluctuates up and down
engine almost stalls when ac is on
en.problem: Dirty throttle body, faulty Idle Speed Control (ISC), or leaking vacuum hoses.
en.action: Keep the AC running stably and avoid sudden throttle releases in traffic.
en.garage_tip: Say: 'Please clean the throttle body, recalibrate the ISC valve, and check for vacuum leaks.'

symptoms: lampu indikator oli warna merah nyala
suara mesin tiba-tiba sangat kasar gemeretak
id.problem: Tekanan oli hilang sama sekali! Bisa karena pompa oli jebol, filter oli mampet total, atau oli benar-benar habis.
id.action: BAHAYA FATAL! Segera matikan mesin detik ini juga! Memaksa jalan 1 menit saja akan membuat mesin hancur total (stang seher bengkok).
id.garage_tip: Sampaikan: 'Indikator oli nyala dan mesin kasar, tolong cek pompa oli dan saringan olinya. Mobil saya derek ke bengkel.'

symptoms: red oil pressure warning light on
engine suddenly sounds very harsh and clattering
en.problem: Zero oil pressure! Could be a blown oil pump, totally clogged oil filter, or zero oil in the engine.
en.action: FATAL DANGER! Turn off the engine this exact second! Driving even for 1 minute will destroy the engine completely.
en.garage_tip: Say: 'The oil light is on and engine sounds rough, please check the oil pump and filter. I towed the car here.'

symptoms: bunyi kletek kletek saat belok patah
ban depan bunyi tek tek saat putar balik
id.problem: CV Joint (As Roda / Kokel) bagian luar sudah aus, pelor hancur, atau karet boot sobek kemasukan pasir.
id.action: Hindari membelokkan setir secara patah (mentok) atau bermanuver terlalu keras.
id.garage_tip: Sampaikan: 'Tolong cek CV Joint roda depan, sepertinya as roda luar sudah kena dan karet boot-nya sobek.'

symptoms: popping sound from front tires on u-turn
en.problem: Worn outer CV joint, broken bearings, or torn boot cover filled with sand.
en.action: Avoid turning the steering wheel to full lock or making aggressive maneuvers.
en.garage_tip: Say: 'Please check the front CV joint, the outer axle seems worn and the boot is torn.'

symptoms: mobil lari ke kiri kanan sendiri
setir narik ke satu sisi saat jalan lurus
id.problem: Sudut roda (Camber/Toe) berantakan, tie rod bengkok, atau mobil sudah lama tidak di-spooring.
id.action: Segera jadwalkan penyetelan kaki-kaki agar ban tidak semakin parah ausnya di satu sisi.
id.garage_tip: Sampaikan: 'Tolong cek tie rod dan long tie rod, lalu lakukan Spooring 3D presisi agar setir lurus lagi.'

symptoms: car pulls to the left or right
steering pulls to one side on straight road
en.problem: Misaligned wheel angles (Camber/Toe), bent tie rods, or lack of regular wheel alignment.
en.action: Schedule a suspension adjustment soon to prevent further uneven tire wear.
en.garage_tip: Say: 'Please check the tie rods and perform a 3D wheel alignment (spooring) to straighten the steering.'

symptoms: mobil mati mendadak saat jalan malam
lampu depan tiba-tiba redup lalu mesin mati
tape mati sendiri lalu mobil mogok
id.problem: Alternator (dinamo ampere) mati total! Mobil hanya berjalan mengandalkan sisa daya aki sampai benar-benar habis.
id.action: Segera menepi. Matikan AC, tape, dan lampu (jika aman) untuk menghemat sisa aki agar bisa jalan sedikit lebih jauh.
id.garage_tip: Sampaikan: 'Alternator tidak ngisi, tolong cek IC regulator atau gulungan alternatornya, mungkin perlu servis/ganti.'

symptoms: car dies suddenly driving at night
headlights dim and then engine stalls
radio shuts off then car breaks down
en.problem: Alternator has completely failed! The car is running solely on reserve battery power until it drains entirely.
en.action: Pull over immediately. Turn off AC, radio, and lights (if safe) to save remaining battery power.
en.garage_tip: Say: 'The alternator isn't charging, please check the IC regulator or alternator coils, it might need a rebuild/replacement.'

symptoms: mobil digas tapi ngempos tidak mau lari
tarikan mobil berat hampa saat diinjak dalam
id.problem: Tekanan bahan bakar lemah akibat filter bensin mampet parah atau motor fuel pump sudah melemah.
id.action: Hindari menginjak pedal gas secara mendadak atau memaksa menyalip kendaraan lain di jalan tol.
id.garage_tip: Sampaikan: 'Tolong cek tekanan bensin (fuel pressure) di rail injektor, sepertinya rotak fuel pump atau filter bensin sudah lemah.'

symptoms: car revs up but acceleration lags
loss of power when pressing gas pedal
en.problem: Low fuel pressure caused by a severely clogged fuel filter or weakening fuel pump motor.
en.action: Avoid stepping heavily on the gas pedal or attempting sudden overtaking maneuvers.
en.garage_tip: Say: 'Please check the fuel pressure at the rail, the fuel pump or filter seems weak and needs replacement.'

symptoms: bunyi jedug di kap mesin dekat kaca saat lewat jalan jelek
bagian atas ban terasa longgar oblak
id.problem: Karet support shockbreaker sudah jebol, pecah, atau mangkok dudukan shock aus.
id.action: Kurangi kecepatan saat melewati jalan tidak rata untuk meredam benturan langsung ke bodi atas.
id.garage_tip: Sampaikan: 'Tolong cek karet support shockbreaker depan, sepertinya sudah jebol dan oblak saat lewat jalan rusak.'

symptoms: thump noise near windshield when hitting bumps
en.problem: Shock absorber upper mount rubber is torn, broken, or worn out.
en.action: Slow down when passing rough roads to cushion direct impacts to the body frame.
en.garage_tip: Say: 'Please inspect the front shock absorber upper mounts; they are blown and causing clunking noises over bumps.'

symptoms: air radiator menyembur keluar dari mesin
asap putih uap air keluar deras dari bawah kap
id.problem: Selang radiator getas dan pecah total, membuat seluruh air pendingin langsung habis dalam hitungan detik.
id.action: MATIKAN MESIN SEGERA! Jangan coba-coba menambah air saat mesin masih panas karena blok mesin bisa retak.
id.garage_tip: Sampaikan: 'Selang radiator mobil saya pecah dan air habis total, tolong ganti selang baru dan cek kondisi mesin.'

symptoms: coolant spraying out of engine bay
heavy steam billowing from under hood
en.problem: Radiator hose cracked and completely burst, causing all coolant to dump out instantly.
en.action: TURN OFF ENGINE IMMEDIATELY! Do not pour cold water into a hot engine to avoid cracking the block.
en.garage_tip: Say: 'My radiator hose burst and coolant drained out completely, please replace the hose and check engine health.'

symptoms: ac mobil tidak dingin sama sekali
id.problem: Freon AC habis karena bocor, magnetic clutch kompresor rusak, atau kipas kondensor mati.
id.action: Matikan AC jika terdengar bunyi kasar dari kompresor dan gunakan ventilasi alami sementara.
id.garage_tip: Sampaikan: 'Tolong cek tekanan freon, kebocoran sistem AC, magnetic clutch dan kipas kondensor.'

en.problem: Low refrigerant due to leaks, faulty magnetic clutch, or failed condenser fan.
en.action: Turn off the AC if the compressor makes unusual noises and use natural ventilation.
en.garage_tip: Say: 'Please inspect refrigerant pressure, AC leaks, magnetic clutch and condenser fan.'

symptoms: ngorok dari kap mesin saat ac hidup
id.problem: Bearing kompresor AC aus, oli kompresor habis, atau kompresor mulai rusak.
id.action: Matikan AC jika bunyi semakin keras agar kompresor tidak macet total.
id.garage_tip: Sampaikan: 'Tolong cek bearing kompresor dan kondisi oli kompresor AC.'

symptoms: grinding noise when ac is on
en.problem: Worn compressor bearing, insufficient compressor oil, or failing AC compressor.
en.action: Turn off the AC if the noise becomes louder.
en.garage_tip: Say: 'Please inspect the AC compressor bearing and compressor oil condition.'

id.problem: Master kopling bocor, ada udara di sistem kopling, atau sinkromes transmisi aus.
id.action: Injak kopling penuh saat memindahkan gigi dan hindari memaksa masuk gigi.
id.garage_tip: Sampaikan: 'Tolong cek master kopling, lakukan bleeding dan periksa sinkromes transmisi.'

en.problem: Leaking clutch master cylinder, air in clutch line, or worn synchronizers.
en.action: Fully depress the clutch pedal before shifting.
en.garage_tip: Say: 'Please inspect the clutch hydraulic system and transmission synchronizers.'

id.problem: Kampas kopling transmisi matic aus, oli transmisi sangat kotor, atau tekanan oli transmisi hilang.
id.action: Jangan dipaksa berjalan karena dapat memperparah kerusakan transmisi.
id.garage_tip: Sampaikan: 'Tolong cek tekanan oli transmisi dan kondisi kampas kopling matic sebelum overhaul.'

symptoms: engine revs but car won't move
en.problem: Worn transmission clutch packs, contaminated fluid or hydraulic pressure loss.
en.action: Do not continue driving.
en.garage_tip: Say: 'Please inspect transmission pressure and clutch packs before recommending overhaul.'

symptoms: mobil tidak bisa starter cuma bunyi
id.problem: Relay starter rusak, aki lemah, atau motor starter macet.
id.action: Periksa kondisi aki sebelum mencoba starter berulang kali.
id.garage_tip: Sampaikan: 'Tolong cek relay starter, aki dan motor starter menggunakan multitester.'

en.problem: Faulty starter relay, weak battery or seized starter motor.
en.action: Check battery condition before repeated start attempts.
en.garage_tip: Say: 'Please inspect the starter relay, battery and starter motor.'

id.problem: Oli power steering kurang, pompa power steering rusak, atau EPS mengalami gangguan.
id.action: Kurangi penggunaan kendaraan sampai sistem kemudi diperiksa.
id.garage_tip: Sampaikan: 'Tolong cek oli power steering, pompa power steering dan modul EPS.'

en.problem: Low power steering fluid, faulty steering pump or EPS malfunction.
en.action: Drive carefully until repaired.
en.garage_tip: Say: 'Please inspect the steering pump, fluid and EPS module.'

id.problem: Roda tidak balance, velg peyang, atau ban benjol.
id.action: Kurangi kecepatan dan hindari berkendara cepat.
id.garage_tip: Sampaikan: 'Tolong balancing keempat roda dan cek kondisi velg serta ban.'

en.problem: Wheel imbalance, bent rim or damaged tire.
en.action: Reduce speed immediately.
en.garage_tip: Say: 'Please perform wheel balancing and inspect rims and tires.'

id.problem: Piringan cakram bergelombang akibat panas berlebih atau aus tidak merata.
id.action: Kurangi kecepatan dan hindari pengereman mendadak berulang.
id.garage_tip: Sampaikan: 'Tolong cek kondisi piringan cakram apakah perlu dibubut atau diganti.'

en.problem: Warped brake rotors caused by overheating or uneven wear.
en.action: Avoid repeated hard braking.
en.garage_tip: Say: 'Please inspect the brake rotors for warping.'

id.problem: Kaliper rem macet, selang rem tersumbat, atau kampas rem aus tidak merata.
id.action: Kurangi kecepatan dan hindari pengereman keras.
id.garage_tip: Sampaikan: 'Tolong cek kaliper rem, pin slider dan kondisi kampas rem kanan kiri.'

en.problem: Sticking brake caliper, blocked brake hose or uneven brake pad wear.
en.action: Drive carefully until repaired.
en.garage_tip: Say: 'Please inspect brake calipers, slide pins and brake pads.'

id.problem: Oli gardan kurang, bearing gardan aus, atau gigi gardan mulai rusak.
id.action: Kurangi kecepatan dan hindari perjalanan jauh.
id.garage_tip: Sampaikan: 'Tolong cek oli gardan, bearing dan backlash gardan.'

en.problem: Low differential oil, worn bearings or damaged differential gears.
en.action: Reduce speed until inspected.
en.garage_tip: Say: 'Please inspect the differential oil, bearings and gear backlash.'

id.problem: Ring piston aus, seal klep bocor, atau dinding silinder sudah aus sehingga oli ikut terbakar.
id.action: Pantau level oli mesin dan hindari perjalanan jauh sebelum diperbaiki.
id.garage_tip: Sampaikan: 'Tolong cek ring piston, seal klep dan kompresi mesin apakah perlu turun mesin.'

en.problem: Worn piston rings, leaking valve seals or worn cylinder walls allowing oil into the combustion chamber.
en.action: Monitor engine oil level and avoid long trips.
en.garage_tip: Say: 'Please inspect piston rings, valve seals and perform a compression test.'

id.problem: Campuran bahan bakar terlalu kaya, filter udara kotor, injektor bocor atau sensor MAF bermasalah.
id.action: Kurangi akselerasi tinggi sampai sistem injeksi diperiksa.
id.garage_tip: Sampaikan: 'Tolong cek injektor, MAF sensor, throttle body dan filter udara.'

en.problem: Rich fuel mixture caused by dirty air filter, leaking injectors or faulty MAF sensor.
en.action: Avoid aggressive acceleration until repaired.
en.garage_tip: Say: 'Please inspect injectors, MAF sensor and air filter.'

id.problem: Filter udara kotor, sensor O2 rusak, MAF sensor bermasalah atau injektor bocor.
id.action: Hindari perjalanan jauh sebelum konsumsi bahan bakar diperiksa.
id.garage_tip: Sampaikan: 'Tolong cek O2 sensor, injektor, throttle body dan scanner OBD2.'

en.problem: Dirty air filter, faulty oxygen sensor, MAF sensor issue or leaking injectors.
en.action: Inspect the fuel system soon.
en.garage_tip: Say: 'Please inspect O2 sensor, injectors and scan the ECU.'

id.problem: Sekring putus, relay horn rusak, saklar klakson bermasalah atau horn sudah mati.
id.action: Gunakan isyarat lain saat berkendara sampai klakson diperbaiki.
id.garage_tip: Sampaikan: 'Tolong cek relay horn, sekring dan saklar di setir.'

en.problem: Blown fuse, faulty horn relay, steering switch or damaged horn unit.
en.action: Repair the horn as soon as possible.
en.garage_tip: Say: 'Please inspect the horn relay, fuse and steering wheel switch.'

id.problem: Alternator lemah, aki mulai soak, bohlam mulai rusak atau grounding kelistrikan kurang baik.
id.action: Kurangi berkendara malam sebelum sistem kelistrikan diperiksa.
id.garage_tip: Sampaikan: 'Tolong cek pengisian alternator, aki dan jalur grounding lampu.'

en.problem: Weak alternator output, failing battery, bad bulb or poor electrical grounding.
en.action: Inspect the charging system soon.
en.garage_tip: Say: 'Please inspect alternator charging, battery and grounding.'

id.problem: Shockbreaker bocor, per melemah atau shock absorber sudah kehilangan daya redam.
id.action: Kurangi kecepatan terutama saat menikung.
id.garage_tip: Sampaikan: 'Tolong cek shockbreaker depan belakang dan kondisi per suspensi.'

en.problem: Leaking shock absorbers or weakened suspension springs.
en.action: Reduce speed especially on corners.
en.garage_tip: Say: 'Please inspect front and rear shock absorbers.'

id.problem: Brake switch rusak atau solenoid shift lock mengalami kerusakan.
id.action: Gunakan tombol Shift Lock darurat bila tersedia.
id.garage_tip: Sampaikan: 'Tolong cek brake switch dan solenoid shift lock.'

en.problem: Faulty brake switch or failed shift lock solenoid.
en.action: Use the emergency shift lock release if available.
en.garage_tip: Say: 'Please inspect the brake switch and shift lock solenoid.'

id.problem: Terjadi kebocoran pada radiator, selang radiator, tutup radiator, waterpump atau reservoir coolant.
id.action: Periksa volume coolant setiap sebelum berkendara dan hindari perjalanan jauh.
id.garage_tip: Sampaikan: 'Tolong lakukan pressure test sistem pendingin dan cari titik kebocoran coolant.'

en.problem: Cooling system leak from radiator, hoses, water pump, radiator cap or coolant reservoir.
en.action: Monitor coolant level before driving.
en.garage_tip: Say: 'Please perform a cooling system pressure test and locate the leak.'

id.problem: Motor kipas radiator rusak, relay fan rusak, sekring putus atau sensor temperatur bermasalah.
id.action: Hindari kemacetan panjang sebelum sistem pendingin diperbaiki.
id.garage_tip: Sampaikan: 'Tolong cek motor fan, relay fan, sekring dan sensor suhu radiator.'

en.problem: Faulty cooling fan motor, relay, fuse or temperature sensor.
en.action: Avoid stop-and-go traffic.
en.garage_tip: Say: 'Please inspect the cooling fan motor, relay, fuse and coolant temperature sensor.'

id.problem: Thermostat macet dalam posisi terbuka sehingga mesin sulit mencapai suhu kerja normal.
id.action: Masih dapat digunakan tetapi konsumsi bahan bakar dapat meningkat.
id.garage_tip: Sampaikan: 'Tolong cek thermostat apakah macet terbuka dan ganti bila perlu.'

symptoms: engine takes too long to warm up
en.problem: Thermostat is stuck open preventing the engine from reaching operating temperature.
en.action: Vehicle can still be driven but fuel economy may decrease.
en.garage_tip: Say: 'Please inspect the thermostat for a stuck-open condition.'

id.problem: Motor actuator central lock rusak, sekring putus atau modul body control mengalami gangguan.
id.action: Pastikan seluruh pintu terkunci secara manual.
id.garage_tip: Sampaikan: 'Tolong cek actuator central lock dan body control module.'

en.problem: Faulty door lock actuator, blown fuse or body control module issue.
en.action: Lock the doors manually until repaired.
en.garage_tip: Say: 'Please inspect the central locking actuator and BCM.'

id.problem: Motor wiper rusak, linkage macet, relay rusak atau sekring putus.
id.action: Hindari berkendara saat hujan deras sebelum diperbaiki.
id.garage_tip: Sampaikan: 'Tolong cek motor wiper, linkage dan relay wiper.'

en.problem: Faulty wiper motor, linkage problem, relay failure or blown fuse.
en.action: Avoid driving in heavy rain until repaired.
en.garage_tip: Say: 'Please inspect the wiper motor, linkage and relay.'

symptoms: mobil susah hidup setelah isi bensin
mesin tidak enak setelah isi bensin
id.problem: Bahan bakar terkontaminasi air atau kualitas bahan bakar buruk sehingga mengganggu sistem pembakaran.
id.action: Hindari memacu kendaraan sampai kualitas bahan bakar dipastikan.
id.garage_tip: Sampaikan: 'Tolong cek kualitas bahan bakar, filter bensin dan lakukan pengurasan tangki bila perlu.'

en.problem: Fuel contamination or poor-quality fuel affecting combustion.
en.action: Avoid aggressive driving until the fuel system is inspected.
en.garage_tip: Say: 'Please inspect the fuel quality and fuel filter.'

id.problem: Engine mounting rusak, busi lemah atau salah satu silinder mengalami misfire.
id.action: Kurangi penggunaan kendaraan hingga sumber getaran diketahui.
id.garage_tip: Sampaikan: 'Tolong cek engine mounting dan lakukan pengecekan misfire menggunakan scanner.'

en.problem: Failed engine mount, ignition misfire or weak spark plugs.
en.action: Drive gently until diagnosed.
en.garage_tip: Say: 'Please inspect engine mounts and scan for misfire.'
